title: DevOps Engineer – Infrastructure
description:
* AWS services – EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda
* On\-premise infrastructure management – servers, storage, backups
* Networking fundamentals – switches, routers, firewalls, VPN, load balancers
* Linux system administration
* CI/CD tools – Jenkins / GitLab CI / GitHub Actions
* Containerisation \& orchestration – Docker, Kubernetes (pods, deployments, services, troubleshooting)
* Infrastructure as Code – Terraform / Ansible
* Monitoring \& logging – Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack
* Scripting – Shell / Python
* Strong troubleshooting \& root\-cause analysis skills
* Security best practices and access management
* Incident response and disaster recovery planning

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain hybrid infrastructure comprising AWS cloud resources and on\-premise servers, switches and routers
* Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for smooth and reliable deployments
* Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot Kubernetes clusters, pods, deployments and services
* Perform root\-cause analysis and troubleshooting for infrastructure, network and application issues

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer****Experience: 4\+**  

**About Aivar Innovations**
Aivar is an AI\-first technology partner where cutting\-edge technology meets industry expertise to supercharge your projects. Our AI\-augmented teams accelerate development, reduce time\-to\-market, and deliver exceptional code quality. We bring together the best minds in tech to craft scalable, repeatable solutions that drive real momentum for your business.  

  

**Role Overview**
We are seeking a passionate DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you’ll help bridge development and operations, ensuring seamless delivery pipelines, efficient infrastructure management, and high\-performing, resilient systems. If you enjoy solving real\-world problems, automating processes, and continuously learning, we’d love to meet you.### **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities*** Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth releases and scalable infrastructure.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement robust security and reliability practices.

* Familiarity with IaC tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Programming experience in Python, Java, or similar.
* Understanding of cloud services on AWS, Azure, or GCP and Eagerness to learn advanced Kubernetes concepts and troubleshooting methods.

* Collaborative spirit with a proactive attitude toward teamwork and aligned goals.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with curiosity to explore infrastructure challenges.
* Adaptable and motivated to stay current with evolving DevOps and cloud technologies.
* Team\-oriented, open to feedback, and eager to share knowledge.

 **Certifications (Optional but Preferred)**  

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or equivalent Linux Foundation certification.
* Any AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certification.

### **Benefits**

 **Why You’ll Love Working at Aivar*** **Learn from Experts:** Work directly with former AWS leaders and AI pioneers.

* **Modern Tech:** Master the latest Generative AI frameworks and cloud\-native architectures.
* **Real\-World Impact:** Build mission\-critical systems used by major global enterprises.
* **Rapid Growth:** Scale your career quickly in a high\-speep

Aivar Innovations is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, age, marital status, caste, or any other protected characteristic, and we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace for everyone.

title: DevOps - Lead
description:
**Role description** **Job Title**
**Lead / Senior DevOps Engineer**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled Lead/Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS, Azure DevOps, Terraform, New Relic, and cloud\-native DevOps practices. The ideal candidate should have deep hands\-on experience in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD automation, observability engineering, containerized deployments, and AI\-driven DevOps (AIOps).

This role requires a technical leader capable of architecting scalable cloud infrastructure, implementing DevOps best practices, driving automation initiatives, and leading cloud transformation programs across enterprise environments.

**Key Primary Skills (Mandatory)**
* AWS Cloud Platform
* Azure DevOps
* Terraform
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* CI/CD Pipeline Design \& Automation
* New Relic Monitoring
* Observability Engineering
* AWS Lambda
* API Gateway
* EC2
* S3
* CloudFront
* SQS
* DynamoDB
* Amazon EKS
* Docker
* DevOps Automation
* Cloud Architecture
* Microservices Architecture
* Blue\-Green Deployment
* Disaster Recovery (DR)
* Git Workflows \& Branching Strategy
* AIOps
* AWS CloudWatch

**Secondary Skills**
* AI\-Driven Infrastructure Automation
* AI\-Assisted Development Tools (ChatGPT, Codex)
* Security \& Compliance Automation
* DevSecOps
* DNS \& SSL/TLS Management
* Kubernetes
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
* Cost Optimization
* Linux Administration
* Shell/Python Scripting
* Monitoring \& Logging Solutions
* Agile \& DevOps Methodologies

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**DevOps Architecture \& Strategy**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade DevOps architecture across multi\-cloud environments.
* Define DevOps standards, governance, security practices, and automation strategies.
* Architect scalable, highly available, and cost\-optimized AWS infrastructure solutions.

**Infrastructure as Code \& Automation**
* Develop and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Create reusable Terraform modules and enforce IaC best practices.
* Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and infrastructure lifecycle management.

**CI/CD \& Deployment Engineering**
* Design and manage CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Automate build, test, deployment, and release workflows.
* Implement Blue\-Green deployments and disaster recovery strategies.
* Define Git workflows and branching standards.

**Cloud \& Container Platform Management**
* Architect and manage AWS services including Lambda, EC2, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, SQS, and DynamoDB.
* Deploy and manage Docker\-based microservices and Amazon EKS environments.
* Configure networking, DNS, SSL/TLS, and security best practices.

**Observability \& Monitoring**
* Implement observability solutions using New Relic and AWS CloudWatch.
* Configure logging, monitoring, ing, and performance optimization.
* Improve system reliability, availability, and operational visibility.

**AIOps \& AI\-Driven DevOps**
* Implement AI\-driven automation and anomaly detection solutions.
* Integrate AI/ML tools into DevOps workflows and operational processes.
* Leverage tools like Codex and ChatGPT to improve engineering productivity.

**Security \& Compliance**
* Implement DevSecOps practices within CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage secrets, access controls, identity management, and compliance standards.
* Ensure infrastructure security and governance compliance.

**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Lead and mentor DevOps engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Cloud Engineering teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Drive innovation, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Multi\-cloud architecture experience
* Exposure to FinOps practices
* Experience with Kafka or event\-driven platforms
* Serverless architecture expertise
* Experience in enterprise modernization projects
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO, PCI\-DSS)
* Experience in large\-scale SaaS environments

**Experience Required**
* 5\+ years of relevant DevOps / Cloud Engineering experience
* Strong hands\-on experience in AWS and Azure DevOps
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale DevOps transformation programs
* Experience managing production\-grade cloud\-native environments

**Preferred Domain**
* Cloud Engineering
* Enterprise SaaS Platforms
* Digital Transformation
* Large\-Scale Enterprise Applications

**Soft Skills**
* Strong leadership and mentoring abilities
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to work in fast\-paced cross\-functional environments
* Innovation\-driven and ownership\-oriented mindset

  

**Skills**  

AWS, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Observability,CI/CD

 **About UST**  

UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future\-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

title: Engineer 2 - Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


This job is responsible for the availability, latency, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning for platforms. It will engage in designing, analyzing and troubleshooting large\-scale distributed systems, debugging and optimizing code and automating routine tasks. It will be part of a team consisting of a mix between software and technology infrastructure backgrounds. It will provide subject matter expertise, resolve complex break/fix scenarios and engage broader teams as necessary. It will partner with engineering, vendors and client services to deliver successful technical solutions. Works with limited supervision and direction while executing associated functions and responsibilities. Follows operational practices and independently determines/develops approaches for non\-routine solutions. Works with moderate guidance in own area of knowledge.**Job Description**


Core Responsibilities  

Engineering technical solutions for infrastructure and application management, monitoring, and operations with standardization and automation focus  

Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to identify and address reliability and performance issues  

Providing cybersecurity support such as vulnerability cleanup, secure server configuration, testing and validation, technical controls implementation and incident remediation  

Working closely with developers to ensure software releases are well\-designed, planned, implemented, released, and monitored  

Measuring and improving reliability, quality and efficiency of platforms  

Working on\-call shift, and support incident prevention, response, and retrospect  

Supporting a variety of complex analytical duties in the planning, deployment, testing and evaluation of products  

Contributing to the design and implementation of reliable and scalable infrastructure solutions with best practices, tool use, and quality assurance  

Monitoring system performance and implementing improvements to optimize reliability, availability, production quality, operational efficiency, and engineering productivity  

Developing and implementing best practices for operational processes and tools to enhance system reliability  

Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance  

.Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.  

Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.  

Employees at all levels are expected to:  

  

Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.  

Own the customer experience \- think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.  

Know your stuff \- be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game\-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.  

Win as a team \- make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.  

Be an active part of the Net Promoter System \- a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company \- by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.  

Drive results and growth.  

Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.  

Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

title: Manager - Cloud & Security Customer Service Operations - Network Operations & Support
description:

We are seeking an experienced Software Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable network automation systems.



This role focuses on building enterprise\-grade automation frameworks, driving standardization, and integrating best practices across CI/CD environments. The architect will define target architecture, automation patterns, and governance frameworks, while collaborating closely with platform, security, and engineering teams to align with business and technology strategy.

* Define the target automation architecture and roadmap aligned with enterprise goals
* Drive simplification, standardization, and reuse across platforms
* Evaluate and recommend strategic automation solutions based on emerging technologies and long\-term business needs


**2\. Business Alignment**


* Translate business and operational requirements into scalable automation designs
* Enable faster delivery of network services by reducing manual effort and increasing reliability
* Ensure automation initiatives align with business outcomes and operational priorities

* Azure DevOps (ADO)
* Python

* Documentation

* Address technical debt and ensure secure automation architecture

* Implement controlled deployment, testing, and rollback strategies to mitigate risk


**6\. Governance \& Standards**


* Define and enforce automation design principles and architectural standards
* Establish documentation frameworks ensuring traceability and auditability
* Govern automation pipelines, scripts, and configurations
* Collaborate with security and platform teams to ensure regulatory compliance

* Strong expertise in:
* Automation frameworks and architecture design

Proficiency in:

Experience with:

* Experience in defining scalable, modular, and reusable automation architecture

### **Experience**


* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale automation solutions

* Experience in banking or regulated industries preferred
